currentCard.explanation: Чтобы перейти на следующий этап, Pac-Man должен съесть все Pac-Dots в лабиринте. Power Pellet ненадолго делает призраков синими и позволяет Pac-Man съесть их.

source.title: BANDAI NAMCO Entertainment: ARCADE GAME SERIES: PAC-MAN — manual

literal.prompt: Что Pac-Man должен съесть в лабиринте игры 1980 года, чтобы перейти на следующий этап?

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L12–L13 identifies the 1980 arcade original and this faithful recreation. L21 explicitly makes eating all Pac-Dots the stage-advance condition. L31–L32 assigns fruit a dot-triggered bonus role; L22 makes ghosts a life-loss threat, and L26–L27 makes Power Pellets temporary enablers of eating ghosts. Thus slot2 is the unique stated progression category in this manual. The untranslated labels create an EASY accessibility issue, and the Pac-Man/eats/dots MAIN substantially reverses existing card66.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Чтобы перейти на следующий этап, Pac-Man должен съесть все Pac-Dots в лабиринте. Power Pellet ненадолго делает призраков синими и позволяет Pac-Man съесть их.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: Its first sentence states the manual L21 progression rule with the necessary all-quantifier. Its second sentence accurately combines L26 and L27: eating a Power Pellet temporarily turns ghosts blue and makes them edible. Two sentences, names Pac-Man and Pac-Dots; does not claim eating ghosts/fruit is required.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Фрукт появляется после того, как Pac-Man съест определённое количество Pac-Dots, и приносит бонусные очки.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L31 says fruit appears after a certain number of Pac-Dots; L32 says eating fruit awards bonus points. This is a concrete fact about the fruit option, explains its optional bonus role without falsely making it the level-clear condition.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Если призрак поймает Pac-Man, тот теряет жизнь.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L22 explicitly states that Pac-Man loses a life when caught by a ghost. This is useful information about the ghost threat itself; the note does not conflate being caught with eating a temporarily blue ghost.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: После определённого количества Pac-Dots появляется фрукт, который приносит бонусные очки.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L31–L32 supports a separate causal effect of collecting Pac-Dots: reaching a threshold causes fruit to appear, and eating that fruit awards bonus points. This is additional information about Pac-Dots beyond the asked stage-advance rule, even though it overlaps the fruit note. Such cross-note overlap is permitted.

sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.literal: Power Pellet ненадолго делает призраков синими, и Pac-Man может съесть их.
sixLiteralCanonicalGroups.individualGround: L26–L27 makes a Power Pellet turn ghosts blue for a short time and allow Pac-Man to eat them. This identifies the own-option function rather than the Pac-Dot progression function.

absoluteLevel.ground: The elementary Pac-Man/eats/dots association may be familiar beyond regular players, but recognizing a mascot does not prove broad knowledge of Pac-Dots versus Power Pellets. Current English-only labels add specific terminology, so exact CURRENT fails broad-adult EASY accessibility. No telemetry/human acceptance claimed.

sourcesLocators.scope: Cultural reach only, not terminology familiarity

defects.ground: Actual CURRENT card66 asks who the round yellow character eating dots in a maze is, key Пакман. Card33 gives Pac-Man/maze and asks the edible progression object, key Pac-Dots. In both directions the deciding association is Pac-Man ↔ eats dots in maze. Card33 adds stage context but does not test a different object, amount, order, or secondary rule; knowing the association asked by66 immediately yields33. This is a substantive direct-reverse/near-duplicate of MAIN under the canonical diversity rule, not merely shared notes or shared franchise.
defects.requiredAction: Within the authorized single directed cycle, select a genuinely independent source-backed EASY MAIN while retaining frozen id/topic/order/difficulty/key position, and recheck affected peers. Do not merely paraphrase dots/Pac-Man in the other direction.

defects.ground: The recognizable broad cultural fact is the yellow character eating dots. Current answers replace ordinary Russian object names with untranslated Pac-Dots and Power Pellets, requiring a Russian player to distinguish game-specific English labels. Museum L199–L208 establishes cultural reach of the character, not familiarity with this terminology. Exact CURRENT therefore does not satisfy broad-adult EASY readability.
defects.requiredAction: Use clear comparable Russian wording for all four options in any repaired independent EASY card; translating only the correct option would create a new clue. Frozen EASY must be preserved.

limitations: Independent semantic INITIAL only. No inherited prior reader judgments, no third complete review, no new source requests. Original diagnostic truncations remain uncured.
